historical_reviews.deepseek: Read-only `sensor get` is suitable only after resolving each exact record name. A literal `TEMP_UBB_GPU0~7` query usually addresses one name, not eight members, and the head-limited fallback cannot prove completeness.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly reclassifies and retains both Dashboard and Server Health Web paths. This review adds explicit threshold-direction/enabled-mask semantics and GPU-slot attribution.
historical_reviews.duplicate_search: No duplicate code variant exists; row 1849's M suffix is unresolved and cannot be assumed equivalent, while rows 1846-1847 cover different GPU sensor domains.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 requires all eight named range members; ED-36 makes installed topology, threshold table and Web mapping readiness inputs; ED-38 preserves logs and engineer verdict ownership.

original_test_intent: Confirm that each applicable UBB GPU0–GPU7 temperature sensor is identifiable and human-readable in BMC Web, reports a plausible current value, and exposes the correct enabled thresholds from the approved GPU/UBB thermal specification.
original_method: The platform owner maps physical UBB GPU slots 0–7 to exact SDR names and both Web locations, defines reading and threshold semantics per slot, then automation gathers complete per-sensor IPMI records while an operator captures the corresponding Dashboard and Sensor Reading entries.
manual_activity: The GPU/UBB thermal owner provides slot 0–7 membership, exact sensor names, threshold masks and limits and confirms that each Dashboard and Server Health row is readable and mapped to the same physical GPU.
required_inputs: Installed UBB GPU0–GPU7 slot/index/model/serial topology and applicability
Exact SDR record name/number/entity for each applicable slot
Meaning and location of each temperature reading plus units, scale, tolerance and freshness
Enabled threshold mask and lower/upper noncritical, critical and nonrecoverable values or explicit unsupported fields
Expected operating range with ambient/load context and warning/critical policy
BMC/SDR/GPU firmware versions and Dashboard/Server Health row mapping
Secret-safe OOB access, complete raw capture and Web screenshot/export method
Thermal aborts, no-clear policy and independent recovery owner
safety_requirements: Expand GPU0 through GPU7 explicitly; never send the range notation as proof of all members
Bind every sensor and Web row to a physical installed GPU slot
Capture full SDR before derived views; do not use the first 100 lines as completeness evidence
Compare only thresholds enabled by the record and distinguish readable numeric values from unavailable/disabled fields
Never modify thresholds, generate load, change fans/GPU controls, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/stale/invalid reading, threshold mismatch, unsafe temperature or BMC instability
Protect credentials and do not automatically retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact row identity and installed UBB GPU topology
Collect full redacted SDR/Sensor inventory and exact per-member `sensor get` output
Parse reading, units, state, threshold-access flags and each enabled limit
Build an eight-slot comparison and prepare matching Dashboard/Server Health rows
Perform no threshold write, thermal stimulus, physical action or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve slot-to-sensor membership and not-applicable positions
Provide expected reading ranges and enabled threshold values
Confirm both Web views are readable and correctly mapped
Review each slot and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `sensor get` is a valid read command for one exact sensor, but the quoted range label does not enumerate GPU0–GPU7; the fallback capped at 100 lines can omit records, password-in-argv is unsafe and no Web evidence is collected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using approved secret-safe OOB access, retain the complete SDR inventory and run `sensor get` separately for every owner-mapped exact UBB GPU sensor, preserving threshold-access flags and values; then reconcile with both specified Web pages.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_UBB_GPU0~7, Dashboard and Server Health paths, human-readable reading/threshold criterion and 1/1-minute estimates are retained; exact names and limits are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a slot-indexed eight-member table, gather exact IPMI records without truncation, normalize enabled thresholds and align the same entries across Dashboard and Server Health screenshots.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns a literal range-name command into a true per-slot enumeration and makes threshold enablement part of acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One literal query or a head-limited SDR cannot demonstrate eight sensors; a current temperature within range does not prove that programmed thresholds match the specification.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Reads are passive, but wrong slot attribution or an incorrect threshold can conceal a GPU thermal protection defect.

project_override_considerations: Partially populated UBB configurations require explicit not-applicable slots. Platforms that intentionally suppress thresholds in one Web view need an approved source-of-truth and visibility rule rather than treating blank fields as automatic PASS.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and adjacent-sensor separation audit
Installed UBB GPU0–GPU7 topology and applicability
Per-slot SDR name/number/entity, reading location, units, state and freshness
Per-slot enabled-threshold mask and expected limit table
Complete redacted SDR plus exact per-sensor outputs with status/timestamps
Dashboard and Server Health screenshots/exports mapped to each slot
Reading and threshold comparison with missing/extra/stale analysis plus GPU/fan/SEL/BMC health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item, Web procedure and criterion consistently target UBB GPU0–7 readings and thresholds. Exact members and limits are absent but no competing target is specified.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The eight-member UBB temperature intent and passive collection method are clear. Slot mapping and threshold values are supplyable project inputs under ED-36.

review_improvement: Replaces the invalid literal range query with per-GPU enumeration, verifies threshold enablement as well as values, and prevents adjacent M-suffixed sensors or truncated SDR output from satisfying this row.
independent_technical_reasoning: IPMI `sensor get` accepts a specific sensor identifier; a tilde range in a testcase title is not an expansion operator. Each GPU record may also enable a different subset of thresholds, so blank or `na` fields must be interpreted through the threshold mask rather than string equality. A slot-indexed mapping is necessary to compare the machine record and both Web views without confusing adjacent GPU sensor families.
